_comment: Month-end risk-free rates used as the Sharpe Ratio denominator's subtrahend. Indian AMCs use the 1-day MIBOR / FBIL Overnight rate as of the factsheet's as-of date, so a Sharpe is only reproducible when the rate and the NAV window describe the SAME month-end. Keyed by month-end ISO date; values are percentages (5.41 means 5.41%).
_source: FBIL Overnight MIBOR, published at https://www.fbil.org.in — record the published month-end value here as each month closes.
_verified: 2026-07-31 = 5.41 reproduces Bandhan Large Cap (108799) factsheet Sharpe 0.476 exactly (CAGR 12.4989 vs 12.4958, StdDev 14.8949 vs 14.90).
